entry.title: This Rat Was Trained to Talk to Humans
entry.summary: A research lab gained popularity in the crypto sphere after its experiment on a rat called Pythia went viral, with a meme coin community rallying behind it. As a result, Pythia can answer questions that require yes or no answers.
